package.description: Visual File And Directory Comparison Tool

en-US.description: Visual File And Directory Comparison Tool
en-US.longDescription: ExamDiff Pro is a powerful and easy-to-use file and directory comparison tool for Windows. It includes numerous helpful features for comparing and merging many kinds of files and folders – from source code to Office documents to Zip archives to files on remote computers. If you've been frustrated with other comparison utilities, you will find that ExamDiff Pro offers a much more user-friendly and customizable experience.
en-US.name: ExamDiff Pro

zh-CN.description: 可视化文件和目录比较工具
zh-CN.longDescription: ExamDiff Pro 是一款强大好用的 Windows 文件及目录对比工具。它包含众多实用功能，可支持源代码、Office 文档、Zip 压缩包乃至远程计算机文件等多种文件与文件夹的比对及合并操作。若您对其他对比工具感到失望，ExamDiff Pro 将为您提供更友好、更可定制化的使用体验。
